text:
Hey there! Cybersecurity is an exciting field where you protect computer systems and networks from cyber threats. Day-to-day, you might be monitoring for suspicious activity, analyzing security breaches, or implementing new security measures. Your main responsibility is to keep data safe and systems running smoothly.

You'll need strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a good understanding of technology. In Florida, cybersecurity professionals can expect to earn about $70,000 - $110,000 annually, and job demand is growing fast!

If you like this, you might also enjoy being a Network Administrator or an IT Auditor. My teammates will cover how to get there.
